```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
arrow::ParquetFileReader$create("data/history.parquet")$GetSchema()
```

```{r}
#| label: history-schema

markets <- arrow::read_parquet("data/markets.parquet")
history <- arrow::read_parquet("data/history.parquet")

joined <- history |>
  left_join(markets |> select(market_id, outcome, resolved_at), by = "market_id") |>
  mutate(
    outcome_numeric = if_else(outcome == "YES", 1, 0),
    probability_error = abs(probability - outcome_numeric),
    days_to_resolution = as.integer(as.Date(resolved_at) - date)
  )

nrow(joined)

joined |>
  summarise(
    mean_error = mean(probability_error),
    median_error = median(probability_error)
  )

joined |>
  summarise(
    final_day_snapshots = sum(days_to_resolution == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    snapshots_1_to_7_days_out = sum(
      between(days_to_resolution, 1, 7),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )
```

```{r}

groups <- read_parquet("data/groups.parquet")

head(market_groups, 5)

nrow(market_groups)
```
